## P4 - `--nics` default `13` exceeds the `12` data ports defined in `PORT_MAP`

**Location:** [ale/vaos/docker/launch.py:171-171](https://github.com/srl-labs/vrnetlab/blob/abbd9338b43ccbf8f21deebbe7ddfe40c326861a/ale/vaos/docker/launch.py#L171-L171)

**Problem:** `PORT_MAP` defines guest NIC indices 0 through `12` with index 2 reserved for the EMP management port, i.e. `12` data ports. But `--nics` defaults to `13` &#40;line 568&#41;, so `self.num_nics = max(nics, len(PORT_MAP) - 1)` always evaluates to `13` with the default. A wired `eth13` maps to guest NIC index `13`, which is beyond the last defined appliance port and has no `PORT_MAP` entry. The comment &#34;expose all defined ports &#40;max&#41;&#34; suggests the intended ceiling is `len(PORT_MAP) - 1` = `12`.

**Trigger:** A topology wires `13` data interfaces to the node, or a user passes `--nics 13` or more based on the help text.

**Impact:** The last data NIC maps to a guest slot with no corresponding appliance port name and no entry in `_log_port_map`; behavior there is undefined and undocumented. Minor, since the appliance only defines `13` adapters total.

**Suggested correction:** Change the `--nics` default from `13` to `12` so it matches `len(PORT_MAP) - 1`, keeping the `max()` guard for smaller explicit values.


## P4 - `self._boot_out` is never reset across VM restarts, so a stale link-up line can shortcut boot detection

**Location:** [ale/vaos/docker/launch.py:253-261](https://github.com/srl-labs/vrnetlab/blob/abbd9338b43ccbf8f21deebbe7ddfe40c326861a/ale/vaos/docker/launch.py#L253-L261)

**Problem:** `bootstrap_spin` accumulates console output into `self._boot_out` and never clears it. When the spin guard triggers &#40;`spins > 6000`&#41;, `stop()` plus `start()` reboot the VM, but output from the previous boot - including a possible `+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up` line - survives. `bootstrap_config` treats a `LINK_UP_RE` hit anywhere in `self._boot_out` as boot-complete, so after a restart it can skip waiting for the fresh boot&#39;s link-up and log in before the switch is ready.

**Trigger:** A VM boot that prints the link-up line but never reaches the login prompt, then goes silent long enough to hit the spin guard and restart.

**Impact:** Low in practice&#58; the premature login is absorbed by `_login`&#39;s retry loop &#40;`LOGIN_RETRIES` times `LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY` = 150 s&#41; and `bootstrap_config`&#39;s `NOT_READY_RE` handling with a 900 s budget. Still, the stale state defeats the purpose of the post-restart wait.

**Suggested correction:** Reset the accumulator on restart, for example set `self._boot_out = b""` in `stop()` or right before `self.start()` in the spin guard, so each boot&#39;s output is judged on its own.


## P4 - No unit test covers the new `_extract_snapshot` helper

**Location:** [ale/vaos/docker/launch.py:327-360](https://github.com/srl-labs/vrnetlab/blob/abbd9338b43ccbf8f21deebbe7ddfe40c326861a/ale/vaos/docker/launch.py#L327-L360)

**Problem:** `_extract_snapshot` is a pure static function with non-trivial edge cases &#40;async console headers interleaved with config lines, the echoed command line, prompt-line detection&#41;, and it is the mechanism backing `containerlab save`. The repository has a unit-test precedent &#40;`fortinet/tests/`&#41;, but this PR adds no test for the new helper.

**Trigger:** A future refactor of the snapshot parser or the prompt/async regexes &#40;`LINE_PROMPT_RE`, `ASYNC_HEADER_RE`&#41; regresses silently; `containerlab save` starts producing corrupted or truncated startup configs.

**Impact:** No automated guard on a user-visible save path; regressions would only surface at runtime.

**Suggested correction:** Add a small pytest module under `ale/vaos/` mirroring `fortinet/tests/`, covering a clean snapshot, an async header line in the middle of the output, and prompt-line handling. Optional but cheap and directly protects the changed behavior.


## Coverage

- Full source review of all four changed paths &#40;Makefile, `README.md`, Dockerfile, `launch.py`&#41; plus the relevant framework code in [`common/vrnetlab.py`](https://github.com/srl-labs/vrnetlab/blob/abbd9338b43ccbf8f21deebbe7ddfe40c326861a/common/vrnetlab.py#L1-L1) &#40;&#95;Console, VM, VR, gen&#95;mgmt, gen&#95;nics, stop/start/work&#41; and the shared `makefile.include/makefile-sanity.include`.
- Verified that `PROMPT_RE`, `LINK_UP_RE`, and `NOT_READY_RE` are raw bytes and therefore compatible with `_Console.expect`&#39;s `pat.decode`&#40;&#41; contract; compiled str patterns &#40;`LINE_PROMPT_RE`, `ASYNC_HEADER_RE`&#41; are only used with direct re calls, consistent with all other launchers.
- Verified the PCI re-slotting produces no slot collisions &#40;eth1 to 1, eth2 to 2, mgmt to 3, eth3 to 4, and so on&#41; and that the launcher&#39;s added dummy NICs for eth1/eth2 preserve the EMP-at-guest-index-2 invariant.
- Verified the ARP probe frame layout and reply-filter byte offsets &#40;sender MAC at 22&#58;28, sender IP at 28&#58;32&#41; and the mgmt&#95;passthrough handling against the patterns used by nokia/sros and extreme/voss.
- The containerlab-side ale&#95;vaos kind and `containerlab save` implementation are outside this repository and could not be verified from the snapshot; the `SAVE_REQUEST`/`SAVE_DONE` handshake is documented in `launch.py` and `README.md` but the counterpart is aspirational for older containerlab versions per the README.
- Tests were not executed &#40;read-only source snapshot, no Docker environment&#41;; the root `README.md` supported-nodes list is explicitly partial, so omitting ale/vaos from it is not treated as a doc gap.

36: +++ b/ale/vaos/README.md
37: @@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
38: +# Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS
39: +
40: +This is the vrnetlab docker image for the ALE OmniSwitch virtual AOS (vAOS) 8.x.
41: +Validated with vAOS 8.11.162.R01 (OS6870 simulation) and containerlab 0.77.0.
42: +
43: +## Building the docker image
44: +
45: +To get the vAOS image, contact your ALE representative or ask for it on the
46: +[Spacewalkers community](https://www.spacewalkers.com/).
47: +
48: +vAOS comes as a GNS3 appliance made of four files. Copy them into this
49: +directory, renamed with a common `vaos-<version>` prefix:
50: +
51: +| GNS3 appliance file           | Rename to                              |
52: +|-------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
53: +| `vAOS8x.qcow2`                | `vaos-8.11.162.R01.qcow2`              |
54: +| `vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz`           | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-ramdisk.gz`         |
55: +| `vAOS8x_bzImage`              | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-bzImage`            |
56: +| `cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar` | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-chassis_info.tar`   |
57: +
58: +Then run `make`. The resulting image is `vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01`.
59: +
60: +## Usage with containerlab
61: +
62: +With the `ale_vaos` kind:
63: +
64: +```yaml
65: +topology:
66: +  kinds:
67: +    ale_vaos:
68: +      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01
69: +      env:
70: +        CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH: "true"
71: +  nodes:
72: +    os1:
73: +      kind: ale_vaos
74: +      startup-config: os1.cfg    # optional
75: +    os2:
76: +      kind: ale_vaos
77: +  links:
78: +    - endpoints: ["os1:1/1/1", "os2:1/1/1"]
79: +```
80: +
81: +With containerlab versions that do not have the `ale_vaos` kind yet, use the
82: +`generic_vm` kind and mount the startup configuration:
83: +
84: +```yaml
85: +    os1:
86: +      kind: generic_vm
87: +      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01
88: +      binds:
89: +        - os1.cfg:/startup-config.cfg:ro
90: +```
91: +
92: +Default credentials: `admin` / `Switch@123`.
93: +
94: +A node needs about 3 minutes to boot and apply its configuration. It reports
95: +healthy once the bootstrap described below is done.
96: +
97: +### Interface mapping
98: +
99: +| Container interface | vAOS port |
100: +|---------------------|-----------|
101: +| eth1 to eth10       | 1/1/1 to 1/1/10 |
102: +| eth11               | 1/1/29A   |
103: +| eth12               | 1/1/30A   |
104: +| management          | EMP       |
105: +
106: +### Bootstrap
107: +
108: +Once the switch has booted (`+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up` on the console),
109: +the launcher logs in on the serial console and:
110: +
111: +1. sets the system name and prompt to the node name,
112: +2. configures EMP with the management address (container address in
113: +   mgmt passthrough mode, 10.0.0.15/24 otherwise),
114: +3. adds the static routes from `EMP_ROUTES`,
115: +4. pushes the startup configuration: `/config/startup-config.cfg` (written by
116: +   containerlab from the node `startup-config`) or `/startup-config.cfg` (bind
117: +   mount with the `generic_vm` kind). AOS CLI, one command per line, lines
118: +   starting with `!` are skipped,
119: +5. runs `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`, then `write memory flash-synchro`.
120: +
121: +Optional environment variables:
122: +
123: +| Variable              | Default               | Description |
124: +|-----------------------|-----------------------|-------------|
125: +| `VAOS_USERNAME`       | `--username`, `admin`      | Console login |
126: +| `VAOS_PASSWORD`       | `--password`, `Switch@123` | Console password |
127: +| `EMP_ROUTES`          |                       | `prefix=gateway` list, comma separated. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is skipped |
128: +| `VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG` | see step 4 above      | Path of the startup configuration |
129: +| `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`     |                       | Extra CLI commands, `;` separated |
130: +| `VAOS_SAVE`           | `true`                | `false` skips `write memory flash-synchro` |
131: +| `VAOS_BOOTSTRAP`      | `true`                | `false` skips the console bootstrap |
132: +
133: +### Saving the configuration
134: +
135: +With the containerlab `ale_vaos` kind, `containerlab save` creates
136: +`/config/.vaos-save-request`. The launcher then runs `write memory flash-synchro`,
137: +writes `show configuration snapshot` to `/config/startup-config.cfg` and reports
138: +the result in `/config/.vaos-save-done`.
139: +
140: +### Serial console
141: +
142: +The serial console is exposed on TCP port 5000: `telnet <node> 5000`.
143: +
144: +With mgmt passthrough, vAOS uses its own MAC address for EMP (ALE OUI `00:d0:1a`).
145: +Once EMP is configured, the launcher learns that MAC with an ARP probe on `tap0`
146: +and sets it on the container `eth0`, so that port 5000 stays reachable on the
147: +node management address.

173: +#!/usr/bin/env python3
174: +#
175: +# vrnetlab launcher for Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS 8.x.
176: +#
177: +# Boots the VM the way the GNS3 appliance (vAOS8x.gns3a) does:
178: +#   qemu -kernel vAOS8x_bzImage -initrd vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz \
179: +#        -append "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0" \
180: +#        -hda vAOS8x.qcow2 -hdb cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar  (both IDE, e1000 NICs)
181: +
182: +import ipaddress
183: +import logging
184: +import os
185: +import re
186: +import signal
187: +import socket
188: +import struct
189: +import subprocess
190: +import sys
191: +import time
192: +
193: +import vrnetlab
194: +
195: +
196: +def handle_SIGCHLD(signal, frame):
197: +    os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)
198: +
199: +
200: +def handle_SIGTERM(signal, frame):
201: +    sys.exit(0)
202: +
203: +
204: +signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_SIGTERM)
205: +signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_SIGTERM)
206: +signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, handle_SIGCHLD)
207: +
208: +TRACE_LEVEL_NUM = 9
209: +logging.addLevelName(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, "TRACE")
210: +
211: +
212: +def trace(self, message, *args, **kws):
213: +    if self.isEnabledFor(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM):
214: +        self._log(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, message, args, **kws)
215: +
216: +
217: +logging.Logger.trace = trace
218: +
219: +# Kernel command line copied verbatim from vAOS8x.gns3a.
220: +# (The inifile/connfile configs already live inside the VM disks.)
221: +KERNEL_APPEND = (
222: +    "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0"
223: +)
224: +
225: +# NIC index (adapter_number) -> OmniSwitch port name, from the vAOS8x.gns3a
226: +# custom_adapters block. Index is the guest NIC enumeration order; index 2 is
227: +# always the EMP (management) port.
228: +#
229: +# We place vrnetlab's management NIC on guest index 2 (= EMP), so EMP is the
230: +# managed interface and every other slot is a usable data port. Result:
231: +#   container ethN -> vAOS port at the matching guest index:
232: +#     eth1 -> 1/1/1   eth2 -> 1/1/2   eth3 -> 1/1/3 ... eth10 -> 1/1/10
233: +#     eth11 -> 1/1/29A   eth12 -> 1/1/30A      (EMP has no container interface)
234: +PORT_MAP = {
235: +    0: "1/1/1",
236: +    1: "1/1/2",
237: +    2: "EMP",      # <- vrnetlab management NIC is mapped here
238: +    3: "1/1/3",
239: +    4: "1/1/4",
240: +    5: "1/1/5",
241: +    6: "1/1/6",
242: +    7: "1/1/7",
243: +    8: "1/1/8",
244: +    9: "1/1/9",
245: +    10: "1/1/10",
246: +    11: "1/1/29A",
247: +    12: "1/1/30A",
248: +}
249: +
250: +# guest NIC index reserved for the management NIC (= EMP)
251: +MGMT_NIC_INDEX = 2
252: +
253: +# ---- Console bootstrap (EMP auto-configuration) -------------------------
254: +# After boot, launch.py logs in on the serial console and configures EMP.
255: +# All settings are optional environment variables (set them with "env:" in
256: +# the containerlab topology):
257: +#   VAOS_BOOTSTRAP   "false" to skip the bootstrap entirely   (default: true)
258: +#   VAOS_USERNAME    console login     (default: --username, admin)
259: +#   VAOS_PASSWORD    console password  (default: --password, Switch@123)
260: +#   EMP_ROUTES       static routes, "prefix=gateway" separated by commas,
261: +#                    e.g. "192.168.200.0/24=192.168.121.254"
262: +#                    A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is
263: +#                    skipped; list the specific management prefixes instead.
264: +#   VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG  path (inside the container) of a startup config to
265: +#                    push after EMP is set. Default: the first non-empty file
266: +#                    of STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS (ale_vaos kind "startup-config:",
267: +#                    or a generic_vm bind mount at /startup-config.cfg).
268: +#                    Format: AOS CLI, one command per line, as in vcboot.cfg
269: +#                    or "show configuration snapshot". Empty lines and lines
270: +#                    starting with "!" are skipped. Keep the prompt ending
271: +#                    in "->" if the config changes it.
272: +#   VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS  extra CLI commands, separated by ";"
273: +#   VAOS_SAVE        "false" to skip "write memory flash-synchro" (default: true)
274: +# Note: containerlab's own USERNAME/PASSWORD env vars (clab/clab@123) are
275: +# deliberately NOT used: the vAOS image does not know that account.
276: +# Startup config locations: /config/startup-config.cfg is where the containerlab
277: +# ale_vaos kind puts the node startup-config; /startup-config.cfg is for a bind
278: +# mount with the generic_vm kind.
279: +STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS = ["/config/startup-config.cfg", "/startup-config.cfg"]
280: +# "containerlab save" (ale_vaos kind) drops SAVE_REQUEST in the mounted config
281: +# dir. launch.py then runs "write memory flash-synchro", stores
282: +# "show configuration snapshot" in SAVED_CONFIG and writes "ok" (or the error)
283: +# in SAVE_DONE, which containerlab waits for.
284: +SAVE_REQUEST = "/config/.vaos-save-request"
285: +SAVE_DONE = "/config/.vaos-save-done"
286: +SAVED_CONFIG = "/config/startup-config.cfg"
287: +# async console messages, e.g. "Sat Oct 31 14:02:19 : vcmNi thread INFO message:"
288: +ASYNC_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^\w{3} \w{3} +\d+ \d\d:\d\d:\d\d : ")
289: +LINE_PROMPT_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w.\-]*-> ?$")
290: +LOGIN_RETRIES = 10
291: +LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY = 15
292: +# CLI prompt: a line that starts with "->" or "<name>->". Not anchored at the
293: +# end of the buffer, because async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4
294: +# operationally up") can be printed right after the prompt.
295: +PROMPT_RE = rb"(?:^|\n)[\w.\-]*-> ?"
296: +# vAOS shows the login prompt before it accepts configuration. Until it is
297: +# ready, config commands answer with one of these errors: wait and retry.
298: +NOT_READY_RE = (
299: +    rb"has not reached the ready state|not permitted during initialization"
300: +)
301: +READY_RETRY_DELAY = 10
302: +READY_TIMEOUT = 900  # seconds
303: +# Boot is complete when this line shows on the console (same check as the
304: +# GNS3 deploy script). Only then do we log in and configure.
305: +LINK_UP_RE = rb"\+\+\+ Link 1/1/1 operationally up"
306: +BOOT_TIMEOUT = 600  # seconds
307: +
308: +
309: +class VAOS_vm(vrnetlab.VM):
310: +    def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode):
311: +        disk_image = None
312: +        kernel = None
313: +        initrd = None
314: +        hdb = None
315: +        for e in sorted(os.listdir("/")):
316: +            if re.search(r"\.qcow2$", e) and "-overlay" not in e:
317: +                disk_image = "/" + e
318: +            elif re.search(r"bzImage$", e):
319: +                kernel = "/" + e
320: +            elif re.search(r"ramdisk.*\.gz$", e):
321: +                initrd = "/" + e
322: +            elif re.search(r"chassis_info.*\.tar$", e):
323: +                hdb = "/" + e
324: +
325: +        if not disk_image:
326: +            raise RuntimeError("No .qcow2 disk image found in /")
327: +
328: +        # ram=2048, smp=2 per the gns3a; driveif/ide + e1000 are vrnetlab defaults
329: +        super(VAOS_vm, self).__init__(
330: +            username,
331: +            password,
332: +            disk_image=disk_image,
333: +            ram=2048,
334: +            smp="2",
335: +            driveif="ide",
336: +        )
337: +
338: +        self.hostname = hostname
339: +        self.conn_mode = conn_mode
340: +        self.port_map = PORT_MAP
341: +        # expose all defined ports (max); vrnetlab only instantiates NICs for
342: +        # interfaces actually wired in the topology.
343: +        self.num_nics = max(nics, len(PORT_MAP) - 1)
344: +        self.nic_type = "e1000"
345: +        self._log_port_map()
346: +
347: +        # Boot via the custom kernel + initrd + append, and attach the second
348: +        # (chassis-info) disk as IDE -> becomes hdb.
349: +        # vrnetlab runs qemu via "shell=True", so the multi-word -append value
350: +        # must be quoted or the shell word-splits it (qemu then treats tokens
351: +        # like "GNS3=1" as bare disk-image args).
352: +        self.qemu_args.extend(
353: +            ["-kernel", kernel, "-initrd", initrd, "-append", '"' + KERNEL_APPEND + '"']
354: +        )
355: +        if hdb:
356: +            self.qemu_args.extend(["-drive", "if=ide,file=" + hdb + ",format=raw"])
357: +
358: +        self.logger.info(
359: +            "vAOS boot files: kernel=%s initrd=%s hda=%s hdb=%s",
360: +            kernel, initrd, disk_image, hdb,
361: +        )
362: +
363: +    # ---- NIC placement --------------------------------------------------
364: +    # vrnetlab enumerates NICs by PCI slot. To get a clean
365: +    # container-ethN -> vAOS-1/1/N mapping with EMP as the management port, we
366: +    # force every NIC onto bridge pci.1 with explicit, ordered slots and
367: +    # reserve the slot at MGMT_NIC_INDEX for the management NIC (= EMP).
368: +
369: +    @staticmethod
370: +    def _eth_to_nic_index(eth_i):
371: +        """container eth index -> guest NIC index (skipping the EMP/mgmt slot)."""
372: +        return eth_i - 1 if eth_i - 1 < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else eth_i
373: +
374: +    @staticmethod
375: +    def _set_slot(dev_str, nic_index):
376: +        """Force a -device string onto pci.1 at slot (nic_index + 1)."""
377: +        dev_str = re.sub(r",bus=pci\.\d+", "", dev_str)
378: +        dev_str = re.sub(r",addr=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+", "", dev_str)
379: +        return dev_str + ",bus=pci.1,addr=0x%x" % (nic_index + 1)
380: +
381: +    def gen_mgmt(self):
382: +        # Put the management NIC on the EMP slot (guest index 2).
383: +        res = super().gen_mgmt()
384: +        for i, tok in enumerate(res):
385: +            if tok == "-device":
386: +                res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], MGMT_NIC_INDEX)
387: +        return res
388: +
389: +    def gen_nics(self):
390: +        # Re-slot each data NIC so container ethN lands on its target guest index.
391: +        res = super().gen_nics()
392: +        # vrnetlab skips NICs above the highest wired ethN, and the guest numbers
393: +        # NICs in enumeration order. If eth1/eth2 are not wired, the management
394: +        # NIC shifts down and is no longer EMP. Always add unconnected dummies.
395: +        present = set(int(n) for n in re.findall(r"netdev=p(\d+)", " ".join(res)))
396: +        for eth_i in range(1, MGMT_NIC_INDEX + 1):
397: +            if eth_i not in present:
398: +                res.extend([
399: +                    "-device", "%s,netdev=p%02d" % (self.nic_type, eth_i),
400: +                    "-netdev", "socket,id=p%02d,listen=:%d" % (eth_i, 10000 + eth_i),
401: +                ])
402: +        for i, tok in enumerate(res):
403: +            if tok == "-device":
404: +                m = re.search(r"netdev=p(\d+)", res[i + 1])
405: +                if m:
406: +                    eth_i = int(m.group(1))
407: +                    res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], self._eth_to_nic_index(eth_i))
408: +        return res
409: +
410: +    def _log_port_map(self):
411: +        """Log the container-interface <-> vAOS-port mapping for the operator."""
412: +        self.logger.info("vAOS NIC mapping (EMP = vrnetlab management):")
413: +        for nic in sorted(self.port_map):
414: +            port = self.port_map[nic]
415: +            if nic == MGMT_NIC_INDEX:
416: +                src = "vrnetlab management (NAT, or container eth0 in mgmt-passthrough)"
417: +            else:
418: +                eth = nic + 1 if nic < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else nic
419: +                src = "container eth%d" % eth
420: +            self.logger.info("  guest NIC%-2d  vAOS %-8s  <-  %s", nic, port, src)
421: +        self.logger.info("  => eth1=1/1/1, eth2=1/1/2, eth3=1/1/3 ... EMP = management")
422: +
423: +    def bootstrap_spin(self):
424: +        """Poll the serial console until the OmniSwitch login prompt appears."""
425: +        if self.spins > 6000:
426: +            self.logger.warning("Too many spins, restarting VM")
427: +            self.stop()
428: +            self.start()
429: +            return
430: +
431: +        (ridx, match, res) = self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 1)
432: +        # keep the boot output, in case the link-up line shows before login:
433: +        self._boot_out = getattr(self, "_boot_out", b"") + res
434: +        if match and ridx == 0:
435: +            self.logger.info("vAOS reached login prompt")
436: +            if os.environ.get("VAOS_BOOTSTRAP", "true").lower() != "false":
437: +                try:
438: +                    self.bootstrap_config()
439: +                except Exception as e:
440: +                    self.logger.error("vAOS bootstrap failed: %s", e)
441: +            self.running = True
442: +            self.tn.close()
443: +            return
444: +
445: +        if res != b"":
446: +            self.logger.trace("OUTPUT: %s" % res.decode(errors="ignore"))
447: +            self.spins = 0
448: +
449: +        self.spins += 1
450: +        return
451: +
452: +    # ---- containerlab save ----------------------------------------------
453: +
454: +    def work(self):
455: +        super().work()
456: +        if self.running and os.path.exists(SAVE_REQUEST):
457: +            self.save_config()
458: +
459: +    def save_config(self):
460: +        """Save the configuration and store a snapshot for containerlab save."""
461: +        self.logger.info("containerlab save requested")
462: +        try:
463: +            os.remove(SAVE_REQUEST)
464: +        except OSError:
465: +            pass
466: +        result = "ok"
467: +        try:
468: +            self.tn.open()
469: +            self.tn.write(b"\r")
470: +            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE, b"login:"], 15)
471: +            if ridx == 1:
472: +                username = os.environ.get("VAOS_USERNAME") or self.username
473: +                password = os.environ.get("VAOS_PASSWORD") or self.password
474: +                if not self._login(username, password):
475: +                    raise RuntimeError("could not log in on the console")
476: +            elif ridx != 0:
477: +                raise RuntimeError("no prompt on the console (is a console session open?)")
478: +            self._send("write memory flash-synchro", timeout=180)
479: +            buf = self._send("show configuration snapshot", timeout=120)
480: +            config = self._extract_snapshot(buf)
481: +            if not config.strip():
482: +                raise RuntimeError("empty configuration snapshot")
483: +            with open(SAVED_CONFIG, "w") as f:
484: +                f.write(config)
485: +            self.logger.info("configuration saved to %s", SAVED_CONFIG)
486: +            self.tn.write(b"exit\r")
487: +        except Exception as e:
488: +            result = "error: %s" % e
489: +            self.logger.error("containerlab save failed: %s", e)
490: +        finally:
491: +            try:
492: +                self.tn.close()
493: +            except Exception:
494: +                pass
495: +            with open(SAVE_DONE, "w") as f:
496: +                f.write(result + "\n")
497: +
498: +    @staticmethod
499: +    def _extract_snapshot(buf):
500: +        """Keep the configuration lines of "show configuration snapshot".
501: +
502: +        Async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4 operationally up") can be
503: +        printed in the middle of a line: "spb+++ Link ...\n isis ..." is
504: +        rejoined as "spb isis ...".
505: +        """
506: +        lines = buf.decode(errors="ignore").replace("\r", "").split("\n")
507: +        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
508: +            if "show configuration snapshot" in line:
509: +                lines = lines[i + 1:]
510: +                break
511: +        out = []
512: +        i = 0
513: +        while i < len(lines):
514: +            line = lines[i]
515: +            i += 1
516: +            if LINE_PROMPT_RE.match(line):
517: +                break  # CLI prompt after the output
518: +            if line.startswith("+++") or ASYNC_HEADER_RE.match(line):
519: +                continue  # async console message on its own line
520: +            pos = line.find("+++")
521: +            if pos > 0:
522: +                # message inserted mid-line: the rest of the line follows it
523: +                while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("+++"):
524: +                    i += 1
525: +                rest = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else ""
526: +                i += 1
527: +                line = line[:pos] + rest
528: +            out.append(line)
529: +        while out and not out[-1].strip():
530: +            out.pop()
531: +        while out and not out[0].strip():
532: +            out.pop(0)
533: +        return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
534: +
535: +    # ---- console bootstrap ---------------------------------------------
536: +
537: +    def _send(self, cmd, timeout=30):
538: +        """Send one CLI command and wait for the "->" prompt. If vAOS says it
539: +        is not ready yet, wait and send the command again."""
540: +        deadline = time.time() + READY_TIMEOUT
541: +        while True:
542: +            self.logger.info("vAOS> %s", cmd)
543: +            self.tn.write((cmd + "\r").encode())
544: +            ridx, _, buf = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE], timeout)
545: +            if ridx != 0:
546: +                self.logger.warning("no prompt after '%s' (continuing)", cmd)
547: +                return buf
548: +            if not re.search(NOT_READY_RE, buf):
549: +                return buf
550: +            if time.time() > deadline:
551: +                self.logger.error("vAOS still not ready after %ds, giving up on '%s'",
552: +                                  READY_TIMEOUT, cmd)
553: +                return buf
554: +            self.logger.info("vAOS not ready yet, retrying in %ds", READY_RETRY_DELAY)
555: +            time.sleep(READY_RETRY_DELAY)
556: +
557: +    def _sync_emp_mac(self, emp):
558: +        """mgmt passthrough: copy the EMP MAC address to the container eth0.
559: +
560: +        vrnetlab gives the container eth0 the MAC of the VM management NIC, so
561: +        that traffic for the ports kept in the container (5000-5007, serial
562: +        console) is accepted by the container. vAOS does not use that MAC for
563: +        EMP but its own, so the launcher learns it with an ARP probe sent to
564: +        the VM on tap0 and sets it on eth0.
565: +        """
566: +        ip = socket.inet_aton(emp.split("/")[0])
567: +        try:
568: +            with open("/sys/class/net/%s/address" % self.mgmt_intf) as f:
569: +                src = bytes.fromhex(f.read().strip().replace(":", ""))
570: +            # ETH_P_ALL: frames from the VM are redirected to eth0 by tc on tap0
571: +            # ingress; only an ETH_P_ALL socket sees them before that
572: +            sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET, socket.SOCK_RAW, socket.htons(0x0003))
573: +            sock.bind(("tap0", 0))
574: +            sock.settimeout(1)
575: +        except OSError as e:
576: +            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync skipped: %s", e)
577: +            return
578: +        # ARP probe: who-has <EMP IP>, sender IP 0.0.0.0
579: +        probe = (b"\xff" * 6 + src + b"\x08\x06"
580: +                 + struct.pack("!HHBBH", 1, 0x0800, 6, 4, 1)
581: +                 + src + b"\x00" * 4 + b"\x00" * 6 + ip)
582: +        mac = None
583: +        deadline = time.time() + 30
584: +        try:
585: +            while mac is None and time.time() < deadline:
586: +                sock.send(probe)
587: +                end = time.time() + 2
588: +                while time.time() < end:
589: +                    try:
590: +                        pkt = sock.recv(2048)
591: +                    except socket.timeout:
592: +                        break
593: +                    # ARP (reply, or gratuitous ARP) sent by the VM from the EMP IP
594: +                    if len(pkt) >= 42 and pkt[12:14] == b"\x08\x06" \
595: +                            and pkt[28:32] == ip and pkt[22:28] != src:
596: +                        mac = pkt[22:28]
597: +                        break
598: +        finally:
599: +            sock.close()
600: +        if mac is None:
601: +            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: no ARP reply from EMP")
602: +            return
603: +        mac_str = ":".join("%02x" % b for b in mac)
604: +        res = subprocess.run(["ip", "link", "set", "dev", self.mgmt_intf, "address", mac_str],
605: +                             capture_output=True, text=True)
606: +        if res.returncode != 0:
607: +            self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: %s", res.stderr.strip())
608: +            return
609: +        self.logger.info("EMP MAC %s copied to container %s", mac_str, self.mgmt_intf)
610: +
611: +    def _login(self, username, password):
612: +        """Log in on the console. The first login prompt can come before AAA
613: +        is ready, so retry a few times."""
614: +        for attempt in range(1, LOGIN_RETRIES + 1):
615: +            self.logger.info("vAOS console login attempt %d as %s", attempt, username)
616: +            self.tn.write((username + "\r").encode())
617: +            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([b"assword:"], 30)
618: +            if ridx != 0:
619: +                self.tn.write(b"\r")
620: +                self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
621: +                continue
622: +            self.tn.write((password + "\r").encode())
623: +            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect(
624: +                [PROMPT_RE, rb"Authentication failure|Login incorrect"], 60
625: +            )
626: +            if ridx == 0:
627: +                self.logger.info("vAOS console login OK")
628: +                return True
629: +            self.logger.warning("vAOS login failed, retrying in %ds", LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
630: +            time.sleep(LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
631: +            self.tn.write(b"\r")
632: +            self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
633: +        return False
634: +
635: +    def _push_config(self, path):
636: +        """Send a startup config to the CLI, one line at a time."""
637: +        with open(path, errors="ignore") as f:
638: +            lines = [l.strip() for l in f]
639: +        cmds = [l for l in lines if l and not l.startswith("!")]
640: +        self.logger.info("pushing startup config %s (%d commands)", path, len(cmds))
641: +        errors = 0
642: +        for cmd in cmds:
643: +            buf = self._send(cmd, timeout=60)
644: +            if re.search(rb"\bERROR\b", buf):
645: +                errors += 1
646: +                self.logger.warning("startup config line rejected: %s", cmd)
647: +        self.logger.info("startup config pushed: %d commands, %d rejected",
648: +                         len(cmds), errors)
649: +
650: +    def bootstrap_config(self):
651: +        """Log in on the serial console and configure EMP (+ optional extras)."""
652: +        username = os.environ.get("VAOS_USERNAME") or self.username
653: +        password = os.environ.get("VAOS_PASSWORD") or self.password

It reports\n95: +healthy once the bootstrap described below is done.\n96: +\n97: +### Interface mapping\n98: +\n99: +| Container interface | vAOS port |\n100: +|---------------------|-----------|\n101: +| eth1 to eth10       | 1/1/1 to 1/1/10 |\n102: +| eth11               | 1/1/29A   |\n103: +| eth12               | 1/1/30A   |\n104: +| management          | EMP       |\n105: +\n106: +### Bootstrap\n107: +\n108: +Once the switch has booted (`+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up` on the console),\n109: +the launcher logs in on the serial console and:\n110: +\n111: +1. sets the system name and prompt to the node name,\n112: +2. configures EMP with the management address (container address in\n113: +   mgmt passthrough mode, 10.0.0.15/24 otherwise),\n114: +3. adds the static routes from `EMP_ROUTES`,\n115: +4. pushes the startup configuration: `/config/startup-config.cfg` (written by\n116: +   containerlab from the node `startup-config`) or `/startup-config.cfg` (bind\n117: +   mount with the `generic_vm` kind). Rename\n+# them with the same prefix, for example for 8.11.162.R01:\n+#   vaos-8.11.162.R01.qcow2              (vAOS8x.qcow2)\n+#   vaos-8.11.162.R01-ramdisk.gz         (vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz)\n+#   vaos-8.11.162.R01-bzImage            (vAOS8x_bzImage)\n+#   vaos-8.11.162.R01-chassis_info.tar   (cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar)\n+# match versions like 8.11.162.R01\n+VERSION=$(shell echo $(IMAGE) | sed -e 's/^vaos-//' -e 's/\\.qcow2$$//')\n+\n+-include ../../makefile-sanity.include\n+-include ../../makefile.include\n+\n+# The common build only copies $(IMAGE)* into docker/. Copy the kernel,\n+# initrd and chassis information disk that come with the qcow2.\n+docker-pre-build:\n+\tcp $(basename $(IMAGE))-ramdisk.gz $(basename $(IMAGE))-bzImage \\\n+\t$(basename $(IMAGE))-chassis_info.tar docker/\n+\n+docker-build-extra:\n+\trm -f docker/*-ramdisk.gz docker/*-bzImage docker/*-chassis_info.tar\ndiff --git a/ale/vaos/README.md b/ale/vaos/README.md\nnew file mode 100644\nindex 0000000..16428c5\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/ale/vaos/README.md\n@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@\n+# Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS\n+\n+This is the vrnetlab docker image for the ALE OmniSwitch virtual AOS (vAOS) 8.x.\n+Validated with vAOS 8.11.162.R01 (OS6870 simulation) and containerlab 0.77.0.\n+\n+## Building the docker image\n+\n+To get the vAOS image, contact your ALE representative or ask for it on the\n+[Spacewalkers community](https://www.spacewalkers.com/).\n+\n+vAOS comes as a GNS3 appliance made of four files. Copy them into this\n+directory, renamed with a common `vaos-<version>` prefix:\n+\n+| GNS3 appliance file           | Rename to                              |\n+|-------------------------------|----------------------------------------|\n+| `vAOS8x.qcow2`                | `vaos-8.11.162.R01.qcow2`              |\n+| `vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz`           | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-ramdisk.gz`         |\n+| `vAOS8x_bzImage`              | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-bzImage`            |\n+| `cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar` | `vaos-8.11.162.R01-chassis_info.tar`   |\n+\n+Then run `make`. The resulting image is `vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01`.\n+\n+## Usage with containerlab\n+\n+With the `ale_vaos` kind:\n+\n+```yaml\n+topology:\n+  kinds:\n+    ale_vaos:\n+      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01\n+      env:\n+        CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH: \"true\"\n+  nodes:\n+    os1:\n+      kind: ale_vaos\n+      startup-config: os1.cfg    # optional\n+    os2:\n+      kind: ale_vaos\n+  links:\n+    - endpoints: [\"os1:1/1/1\", \"os2:1/1/1\"]\n+```\n+\n+With containerlab versions that do not have the `ale_vaos` kind yet, use the\n+`generic_vm` kind and mount the startup configuration:\n+\n+```yaml\n+    os1:\n+      kind: generic_vm\n+      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01\n+      binds:\n+        - os1.cfg:/startup-config.cfg:ro\n+```\n+\n+Default credentials: `admin` / `Switch@123`.\n+\n+A node needs about 3 minutes to boot and apply its configuration. It reports\n+healthy once the bootstrap described below is done.\n+\n+### Interface mapping\n+\n+| Container interface | vAOS port |\n+|---------------------|-----------|\n+| eth1 to eth10       | 1/1/1 to 1/1/10 |\n+| eth11               | 1/1/29A   |\n+| eth12               | 1/1/30A   |\n+| management          | EMP       |\n+\n+### Bootstrap\n+\n+Once the switch has booted (`+++ Link 1/1/1 operationally up` on the console),\n+the launcher logs in on the serial console and:\n+\n+1. sets the system name and prompt to the node name,\n+2. configures EMP with the management address (container address in\n+   mgmt passthrough mode, 10.0.0.15/24 otherwise),\n+3. adds the static routes from `EMP_ROUTES`,\n+4. pushes the startup configuration: `/config/startup-config.cfg` (written by\n+   containerlab from the node `startup-config`) or `/startup-config.cfg` (bind\n+   mount with the `generic_vm` kind). AOS CLI, one command per line, lines\n+   starting with `!` are skipped,\n+5. runs `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`, then `write memory flash-synchro`.\n+\n+Optional environment variables:\n+\n+| Variable              | Default               | Description |\n+|-----------------------|-----------------------|-------------|\n+| `VAOS_USERNAME`       | `--username`, `admin`      | Console login |\n+| `VAOS_PASSWORD`       | `--password`, `Switch@123` | Console password |\n+| `EMP_ROUTES`          |                       | `prefix=gateway` list, comma separated. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is skipped |\n+| `VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG` | see step 4 above      | Path of the startup configuration |\n+| `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS`     |                       | Extra CLI commands, `;` separated |\n+| `VAOS_SAVE`           | `true`                | `false` skips `write memory flash-synchro` |\n+| `VAOS_BOOTSTRAP`      | `true`                | `false` skips the console bootstrap |\n+\n+### Saving the configuration\n+\n+With the containerlab `ale_vaos` kind, `containerlab save` creates\n+`/config/.vaos-save-request`. The launcher then runs `write memory flash-synchro`,\n+writes `show configuration snapshot` to `/config/startup-config.cfg` and reports\n+the result in `/config/.vaos-save-done`.\n+\n+### Serial console\n+\n+The serial console is exposed on TCP port 5000: `telnet <node> 5000`.\n+\n+With mgmt passthrough, vAOS uses its own MAC address for EMP (ALE OUI `00:d0:1a`).\n+Once EMP is configured, the launcher learns that MAC with an ARP probe on `tap0`\n+and sets it on the container `eth0`, so that port 5000 stays reachable on the\n+node management address.\ndiff --git a/ale/vaos/docker/Dockerfile b/ale/vaos/docker/Dockerfile\nnew file mode 100644\nindex 0000000..86cc8e1\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/ale/vaos/docker/Dockerfile\n@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@\n+FROM ghcr.io/srl-labs/vrnetlab-base:0.3.0\n+\n+RUN apt-get update -qy \\\n+ && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-system-x86 qemu-utils telnet \\\n+ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*\n+\n+ARG IMAGE\n+# vAOS disk (hda), then kernel, initrd and chassis information disk (hdb)\n+COPY $IMAGE* /\n+COPY *-ramdisk.gz *-bzImage *-chassis_info.tar /\n+COPY *.py /\n+\n+EXPOSE 22 161/udp 830 5000 10000-10099\ndiff --git a/ale/vaos/docker/launch.py b/ale/vaos/docker/launch.py\nnew file mode 100755\nindex 0000000..84eb0a9\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/ale/vaos/docker/launch.py\n@@ -0,0 +1,582 @@\n+#!/usr/bin/env python3\n+#\n+# vrnetlab launcher for Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS 8.x.\n+#\n+# Boots the VM the way the GNS3 appliance (vAOS8x.gns3a) does:\n+#   qemu -kernel vAOS8x_bzImage -initrd vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz \\\n+#        -append \"console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0\" \\\n+#        -hda vAOS8x.qcow2 -hdb cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar  (both IDE, e1000 NICs)\n+\n+import ipaddress\n+import logging\n+import os\n+import re\n+import signal\n+import socket\n+import struct\n+import subprocess\n+import sys\n+import time\n+\n+import vrnetlab\n+\n+\n+def handle_SIGCHLD(signal, frame):\n+    os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)\n+\n+\n+def handle_SIGTERM(signal, frame):\n+    sys.exit(0)\n+\n+\n+signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_SIGTERM)\n+signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_SIGTERM)\n+signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, handle_SIGCHLD)\n+\n+TRACE_LEVEL_NUM = 9\n+logging.addLevelName(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, \"TRACE\")\n+\n+\n+def trace(self, message, *args, **kws):\n+    if self.isEnabledFor(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM):\n+        self._log(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, message, args, **kws)\n+\n+\n+logging.Logger.trace = trace\n+\n+# Kernel command line copied verbatim from vAOS8x.gns3a.\n+# (The inifile/connfile configs already live inside the VM disks.)\n+KERNEL_APPEND = (\n+    \"console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0\"\n+)\n+\n+# NIC index (adapter_number) -> OmniSwitch port name, from the vAOS8x.gns3a\n+# custom_adapters block. Index is the guest NIC enumeration order; index 2 is\n+# always the EMP (management) port.\n+#\n+# We place vrnetlab's management NIC on guest index 2 (= EMP), so EMP is the\n+# managed interface and every other slot is a usable data port. Result:\n+#   container ethN -> vAOS port at the matching guest index:\n+#     eth1 -> 1/1/1   eth2 -> 1/1/2   eth3 -> 1/1/3 ... eth10 -> 1/1/10\n+#     eth11 -> 1/1/29A   eth12 -> 1/1/30A      (EMP has no container interface)\n+PORT_MAP = {\n+    0: \"1/1/1\",\n+    1: \"1/1/2\",\n+    2: \"EMP\",      # <- vrnetlab management NIC is mapped here\n+    3: \"1/1/3\",\n+    4: \"1/1/4\",\n+    5: \"1/1/5\",\n+    6: \"1/1/6\",\n+    7: \"1/1/7\",\n+    8: \"1/1/8\",\n+    9: \"1/1/9\",\n+    10: \"1/1/10\",\n+    11: \"1/1/29A\",\n+    12: \"1/1/30A\",\n+}\n+\n+# guest NIC index reserved for the management NIC (= EMP)\n+MGMT_NIC_INDEX = 2\n+\n+# ---- Console bootstrap (EMP auto-configuration) -------------------------\n+# After boot, launch.py logs in on the serial console and configures EMP.\n+# All settings are optional environment variables (set them with \"env:\" in\n+# the containerlab topology):\n+#   VAOS_BOOTSTRAP   \"false\" to skip the bootstrap entirely   (default: true)\n+#   VAOS_USERNAME    console login     (default: --username, admin)\n+#   VAOS_PASSWORD    console password  (default: --password, Switch@123)\n+#   EMP_ROUTES       static routes, \"prefix=gateway\" separated by commas,\n+#                    e.g. \"192.168.200.0/24=192.168.121.254\"\n+#                    A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is\n+#                    skipped; list the specific management prefixes instead.\n+#   VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG  path (inside the container) of a startup config to\n+#                    push after EMP is set. Default: the first non-empty file\n+#                    of STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS (ale_vaos kind \"startup-config:\",\n+#                    or a generic_vm bind mount at /startup-config.cfg).\n+#                    Format: AOS CLI, one command per line, as in vcboot.cfg\n+#                    or \"show configuration snapshot\". Empty lines and lines\n+#                    starting with \"!\" are skipped. Keep the prompt ending\n+#                    in \"->\" if the config changes it.\n+#   VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS  extra CLI commands, separated by \";\"\n+#   VAOS_SAVE        \"false\" to skip \"write memory flash-synchro\" (default: true)\n+# Note: containerlab's own USERNAME/PASSWORD env vars (clab/clab@123) are\n+# deliberately NOT used: the vAOS image does not know that account.\n+# Startup config locations: /config/startup-config.cfg is where the containerlab\n+# ale_vaos kind puts the node startup-config; /startup-config.cfg is for a bind\n+# mount with the generic_vm kind.\n+STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS = [\"/config/startup-config.cfg\", \"/startup-config.cfg\"]\n+# \"containerlab save\" (ale_vaos kind) drops SAVE_REQUEST in the mounted config\n+# dir. launch.py then runs \"write memory flash-synchro\", stores\n+# \"show configuration snapshot\" in SAVED_CONFIG and writes \"ok\" (or the error)\n+# in SAVE_DONE, which containerlab waits for.\n+SAVE_REQUEST = \"/config/.vaos-save-request\"\n+SAVE_DONE = \"/config/.vaos-save-done\"\n+SAVED_CONFIG = \"/config/startup-config.cfg\"\n+# async console messages, e.g. \"Sat Oct 31 14:02:19 : vcmNi thread INFO message:\"\n+ASYNC_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\w{3} \\w{3} +\\d+ \\d\\d:\\d\\d:\\d\\d : \")\n+LINE_PROMPT_RE = re.compile(r\"^[\\w.\\-]*-> ?$\")\n+LOGIN_RETRIES = 10\n+LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY = 15\n+# CLI prompt: a line that starts with \"->\" or \"<name>->\". Not anchored at the\n+# end of the buffer, because async console messages (\"+++ Link 1/1/4\n+# operationally up\") can be printed right after the prompt.\n+PROMPT_RE = rb\"(?:^|\\n)[\\w.\\-]*-> ?\"\n+# vAOS shows the login prompt before it accepts configuration. Until it is\n+# ready, config commands answer with one of these errors: wait and retry.\n+NOT_READY_RE = (\n+    rb\"has not reached the ready state|not permitted during initialization\"\n+)\n+READY_RETRY_DELAY = 10\n+READY_TIMEOUT = 900  # seconds\n+# Boot is complete when this line shows on the console (same check as the\n+# GNS3 deploy script). Only then do we log in and configure.\n+LINK_UP_RE = rb\"\\+\\+\\+ Link 1/1/1 operationally up\"\n+BOOT_TIMEOUT = 600  # seconds\n+\n+\n+class VAOS_vm(vrnetlab.VM):\n+    def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode):\n+        disk_image = None\n+        kernel = None\n+        initrd = None\n+        hdb = None\n+        for e in sorted(os.listdir(\"/\")):\n+            if re.search(r\"\\.qcow2$\", e) and \"-overlay\" not in e:\n+                disk_image = \"/\" + e\n+            elif re.search(r\"bzImage$\", e):\n+                kernel = \"/\" + e\n+            elif re.search(r\"ramdisk.*\\.gz$\", e):\n+                initrd = \"/\" + e\n+            elif re.search(r\"chassis_info.*\\.tar$\", e):\n+                hdb = \"/\" + e\n+\n+        if not disk_image:\n+            raise RuntimeError(\"No .qcow2 disk image found in /\")\n+\n+        # ram=2048, smp=2 per the gns3a; driveif/ide + e1000 are vrnetlab defaults\n+        super(VAOS_vm, self).__init__(\n+            username,\n+            password,\n+            disk_image=disk_image,\n+            ram=2048,\n+            smp=\"2\",\n+            driveif=\"ide\",\n+        )\n+\n+        self.hostname = hostname\n+        self.conn_mode = conn_mode\n+        self.port_map = PORT_MAP\n+        # expose all defined ports (max); vrnetlab only instantiates NICs for\n+        # interfaces actually wired in the topology.\n+        self.num_nics = max(nics, len(PORT_MAP) - 1)\n+        self.nic_type = \"e1000\"\n+        self._log_port_map()\n+\n+        # Boot via the custom kernel + initrd + append, and attach the second\n+        # (chassis-info) disk as IDE -> becomes hdb.\n+        # vrnetlab runs qemu via \"shell=True\", so the multi-word -append value\n+        # must be quoted or the shell word-splits it (qemu then treats tokens\n+        # like \"GNS3=1\" as bare disk-image args).\n+        self.qemu_args.extend(\n+            [\"-kernel\", kernel, \"-initrd\", initrd, \"-append\", '\"' + KERNEL_APPEND + '\"']\n+        )\n+        if hdb:\n+            self.qemu_args.extend([\"-drive\", \"if=ide,file=\" + hdb + \",format=raw\"])\n+\n+        self.logger.info(\n+            \"vAOS boot files: kernel=%s initrd=%s hda=%s hdb=%s\",\n+            kernel, initrd, disk_image, hdb,\n+        )\n+\n+    # ---- NIC placement --------------------------------------------------\n+    # vrnetlab enumerates NICs by PCI slot. To get a clean\n+    # container-ethN -> vAOS-1/1/N mapping with EMP as the management port, we\n+    # force every NIC onto bridge pci.1 with explicit, ordered slots and\n+    # reserve the slot at MGMT_NIC_INDEX for the management NIC (= EMP).\n+\n+    @staticmethod\n+    def _eth_to_nic_index(eth_i):\n+        \"\"\"container eth index -> guest NIC index (skipping the EMP/mgmt slot).\"\"\"\n+        return eth_i - 1 if eth_i - 1 < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else eth_i\n+\n+    @staticmethod\n+    def _set_slot(dev_str, nic_index):\n+        \"\"\"Force a -device string onto pci.1 at slot (nic_index + 1).\"\"\"\n+        dev_str = re.sub(r\",bus=pci\\.\\d+\", \"\", dev_str)\n+        dev_str = re.sub(r\",addr=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+\", \"\", dev_str)\n+        return dev_str + \",bus=pci.1,addr=0x%x\" % (nic_index + 1)\n+\n+    def gen_mgmt(self):\n+        # Put the management NIC on the EMP slot (guest index 2).\n+        res = super().gen_mgmt()\n+        for i, tok in enumerate(res):\n+            if tok == \"-device\":\n+                res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], MGMT_NIC_INDEX)\n+        return res\n+\n+    def gen_nics(self):\n+        # Re-slot each data NIC so container ethN lands on its target guest index.\n+        res = super().gen_nics()\n+        # vrnetlab skips NICs above the highest wired ethN, and the guest numbers\n+        # NICs in enumeration order. If eth1/eth2 are not wired, the management\n+        # NIC shifts down and is no longer EMP. Always add unconnected dummies.\n+        present = set(int(n) for n in re.findall(r\"netdev=p(\\d+)\", \" \".join(res)))\n+        for eth_i in range(1, MGMT_NIC_INDEX + 1):\n+            if eth_i not in present:\n+                res.extend([\n+                    \"-device\", \"%s,netdev=p%02d\" % (self.nic_type, eth_i),\n+                    \"-netdev\", \"socket,id=p%02d,listen=:%d\" % (eth_i, 10000 + eth_i),\n+                ])\n+        for i, tok in enumerate(res):\n+            if tok == \"-device\":\n+                m = re.search(r\"netdev=p(\\d+)\", res[i + 1])\n+                if m:\n+                    eth_i = int(m.group(1))\n+                    res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], self._eth_to_nic_index(eth_i))\n+        return res\n+\n+    def _log_port_map(self):\n+        \"\"\"Log the container-interface <-> vAOS-port mapping for the operator.\"\"\"\n+        self.logger.info(\"vAOS NIC mapping (EMP = vrnetlab management):\")\n+        for nic in sorted(self.port_map):\n+            port = self.port_map[nic]\n+            if nic == MGMT_NIC_INDEX:\n+                src = \"vrnetlab management (NAT, or container eth0 in mgmt-passthrough)\"\n+            else:\n+                eth = nic + 1 if nic < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else nic\n+                src = \"container eth%d\" % eth\n+            self.logger.info(\"  guest NIC%-2d  vAOS %-8s  <-  %s\", nic, port, src)\n+        self.logger.info(\"  => eth1=1/1/1, eth2=1/1/2, eth3=1/1/3 ... EMP = management\")\n+\n+    def bootstrap_spin(self):\n+        \"\"\"Poll the serial console until the OmniSwitch login prompt appears.\"\"\"\n+        if self.spins > 6000:\n+            self.logger.warning(\"Too many spins, restarting VM\")\n+            self.stop()\n+            self.start()\n+            return\n+\n+        (ridx, match, res) = self.tn.expect([b\"login:\"], 1)\n+        # keep the boot output, in case the link-up line shows before login:\n+        self._boot_out = getattr(self, \"_boot_out\", b\"\") + res\n+        if match and ridx == 0:\n+            self.logger.info(\"vAOS reached login prompt\")\n+            if os.environ.get(\"VAOS_BOOTSTRAP\", \"true\").lower() != \"false\":\n+                try:\n+                    self.bootstrap_config()\n+                except Exception as e:\n+                    self.logger.error(\"vAOS bootstrap failed: %s\", e)\n+            self.running = True\n+            self.tn.close()\n+            return\n+\n+        if res != b\"\":\n+            self.logger.trace(\"OUTPUT: %s\" % res.decode(errors=\"ignore\"))\n+            self.spins = 0\n+\n+        self.spins += 1\n+        return\n+\n+    # ---- containerlab save ----------------------------------------------\n+\n+    def work(self):\n+        super().work()\n+        if self.running and os.path.exists(SAVE_REQUEST):\n+            self.save_config()\n+\n+    def save_config(self):\n+        \"\"\"Save the configuration and store a snapshot for containerlab save.\"\"\"\n+        self.logger.info(\"containerlab save requested\")\n+        try:\n+            os.remove(SAVE_REQUEST)\n+        except OSError:\n+            pass\n+        result = \"ok\"\n+        try:\n+            self.tn.open()\n+            self.tn.write(b\"\\r\")\n+            ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE, b\"login:\"], 15)\n+            if ridx == 1:\n+                username = os.environ.get(\"VAOS_USERNAME\") or self.username\n+                password = os.environ.get(\"VAOS_PASSWORD\") or self.password\n+                if not self._login(username, password):\n+                    raise RuntimeError(\"could not log in on the console\")\n+            elif ridx != 0:\n+                raise RuntimeError(\"no prompt on the console (is a console session open?)\")\n+            self._send(\"write memory flash-synchro\", timeout=180)\n+            buf = self._send(\"show configuration snapshot\", timeout=120)\n+            config = self._extract_snapshot(buf)\n+            if not config.strip():\n+                raise RuntimeError(\"empty configuration snapshot\")\n+            with open(SAVED_CONFIG, \"w\") as f:\n+                f.write(config)\n+            self.logger.info(\"configuration saved to %s\", SAVED_CONFIG)\n+            self.tn.write(b\"exit\\r\")\n+        except Exception as e:\n+            result = \"error: %s\" % e\n+            self.logger.error(\"containerlab save failed: %s\", e)\n+        finally:\n+            try:\n+                self.tn.close()\n+            except Exception:\n+                pass\n+            with open(SAVE_DONE, \"w\") as f:\n+                f.write(result + \"\\n\")\n+\n+    @staticmethod\n+    def _extract_snapshot(buf):\n+        \"\"\"Keep the configuration lines of \"show configuration snapshot\".\n+\n+        Async console messages (\"+++ Link 1/1/4 operationally up\") can be\n+        printed in the middle of a line: \"spb+++ Link ...\\n isis ...\" is\n+        rejoined as \"spb isis ...\".\n+        \"\"\"\n+        lines = buf.decode(errors=\"ignore\").replace(\"\\r\", \"\").split(\"\\n\")\n+        for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n+            if \"show configuration snapshot\" in line:\n+                lines = lines[i + 1:]\n+                break\n+        out = []\n+        i = 0\n+        while i < len(lines):\n+            line = lines[i]\n+            i += 1\n+            if LINE_PROMPT_RE.match(line):\n+                break  # CLI prompt after the output\n+            if line.startswith(\"+++\") or ASYNC_HEADER_RE.match(line):\n+                continue  # async console message on its own line\n+            pos = line.find(\"+++\")\n+            if pos > 0:\n+                # message inserted mid-line: the rest of the line follows it\n+                while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith(\"+++\"):\n+                    i += 1\n+                rest = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else \"\"\n+                i += 1\n+                line = line[:pos] + rest\n+            out.append(line)\n+        while out and not out[-1].strip():\n+            out.pop()\n+        while out and not out[0].strip():\n+            out.pop(0)\n+        return \"\\n\".join(out) + \"\\n\"\n+\n+    # ---- console bootstrap ---------------------------------------------\n+\n+    def _send(self, cmd, timeout=30):\n+        \"\"\"Send one CLI command and wait for the \"->\" prompt. 12: # match versions like 8.11.162.R01
13: VERSION=$(shell echo $(IMAGE) | sed -e 's/^vaos-//' -e 's/\.qcow2$$//')
14: 
15: -include ../../makefile-sanity.include
16: -include ../../makefile.include
17:

<content>
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: #
3: # vrnetlab launcher for Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS 8.x.
4: #
5: # Boots the VM the way the GNS3 appliance (vAOS8x.gns3a) does:
6: #   qemu -kernel vAOS8x_bzImage -initrd vAOS8x_ramdisk.gz \
7: #        -append "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0" \
8: #        -hda vAOS8x.qcow2 -hdb cmm_chassis_info_vAOS8x.tar  (both IDE, e1000 NICs)
9: 
10: import ipaddress
11: import logging
12: import os
13: import re
14: import signal
15: import socket
16: import struct
17: import subprocess
18: import sys
19: import time
20: 
21: import vrnetlab
22: 
23: 
24: def handle_SIGCHLD(signal, frame):
25:     os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)
26: 
27: 
28: def handle_SIGTERM(signal, frame):
29:     sys.exit(0)
30: 
31: 
32: signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_SIGTERM)
33: signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_SIGTERM)
34: signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, handle_SIGCHLD)
35: 
36: TRACE_LEVEL_NUM = 9
37: logging.addLevelName(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, "TRACE")
38: 
39: 
40: def trace(self, message, *args, **kws):
41:     if self.isEnabledFor(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM):
42:         self._log(TRACE_LEVEL_NUM, message, args, **kws)
43: 
44: 
45: logging.Logger.trace = trace
46: 
47: # Kernel command line copied verbatim from vAOS8x.gns3a.
48: # (The inifile/connfile configs already live inside the VM disks.)
49: KERNEL_APPEND = (
50:     "console=ttyS0 GNS3=1 inifile=vAOS8x.ini connfile=vAOS8x_fab.con loglevel=0"
51: )
52: 
53: # NIC index (adapter_number) -> OmniSwitch port name, from the vAOS8x.gns3a
54: # custom_adapters block. Index is the guest NIC enumeration order; index 2 is
55: # always the EMP (management) port.
56: #
57: # We place vrnetlab's management NIC on guest index 2 (= EMP), so EMP is the
58: # managed interface and every other slot is a usable data port. Result:
59: #   container ethN -> vAOS port at the matching guest index:
60: #     eth1 -> 1/1/1   eth2 -> 1/1/2   eth3 -> 1/1/3 ... eth10 -> 1/1/10
61: #     eth11 -> 1/1/29A   eth12 -> 1/1/30A      (EMP has no container interface)
62: PORT_MAP = {
63:     0: "1/1/1",
64:     1: "1/1/2",
65:     2: "EMP",      # <- vrnetlab management NIC is mapped here
66:     3: "1/1/3",
67:     4: "1/1/4",
68:     5: "1/1/5",
69:     6: "1/1/6",
70:     7: "1/1/7",
71:     8: "1/1/8",
72:     9: "1/1/9",
73:     10: "1/1/10",
74:     11: "1/1/29A",
75:     12: "1/1/30A",
76: }
77: 
78: # guest NIC index reserved for the management NIC (= EMP)
79: MGMT_NIC_INDEX = 2
80: 
81: # ---- Console bootstrap (EMP auto-configuration) -------------------------
82: # After boot, launch.py logs in on the serial console and configures EMP.
83: # All settings are optional environment variables (set them with "env:" in
84: # the containerlab topology):
85: #   VAOS_BOOTSTRAP   "false" to skip the bootstrap entirely   (default: true)
86: #   VAOS_USERNAME    console login     (default: --username, admin)
87: #   VAOS_PASSWORD    console password  (default: --password, Switch@123)
88: #   EMP_ROUTES       static routes, "prefix=gateway" separated by commas,
89: #                    e.g. "192.168.200.0/24=192.168.121.254"
90: #                    A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is
91: #                    skipped; list the specific management prefixes instead.
92: #   VAOS_STARTUP_CONFIG  path (inside the container) of a startup config to
93: #                    push after EMP is set. Default: the first non-empty file
94: #                    of STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS (ale_vaos kind "startup-config:",
95: #                    or a generic_vm bind mount at /startup-config.cfg).
96: #                    Format: AOS CLI, one command per line, as in vcboot.cfg
97: #                    or "show configuration snapshot". Empty lines and lines
98: #                    starting with "!" are skipped. Keep the prompt ending
99: #                    in "->" if the config changes it.
100: #   VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS  extra CLI commands, separated by ";"
101: #   VAOS_SAVE        "false" to skip "write memory flash-synchro" (default: true)
102: # Note: containerlab's own USERNAME/PASSWORD env vars (clab/clab@123) are
103: # deliberately NOT used: the vAOS image does not know that account.
104: # Startup config locations: /config/startup-config.cfg is where the containerlab
105: # ale_vaos kind puts the node startup-config; /startup-config.cfg is for a bind
106: # mount with the generic_vm kind.
107: STARTUP_CONFIG_PATHS = ["/config/startup-config.cfg", "/startup-config.cfg"]
108: # "containerlab save" (ale_vaos kind) drops SAVE_REQUEST in the mounted config
109: # dir. launch.py then runs "write memory flash-synchro", stores
110: # "show configuration snapshot" in SAVED_CONFIG and writes "ok" (or the error)
111: # in SAVE_DONE, which containerlab waits for.
112: SAVE_REQUEST = "/config/.vaos-save-request"
113: SAVE_DONE = "/config/.vaos-save-done"
114: SAVED_CONFIG = "/config/startup-config.cfg"
115: # async console messages, e.g. "Sat Oct 31 14:02:19 : vcmNi thread INFO message:"
116: ASYNC_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^\w{3} \w{3} +\d+ \d\d:\d\d:\d\d : ")
117: LINE_PROMPT_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w.\-]*-> ?$")
118: LOGIN_RETRIES = 10
119: LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY = 15
120: # CLI prompt: a line that starts with "->" or "<name>->". Not anchored at the
121: # end of the buffer, because async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4
122: # operationally up") can be printed right after the prompt.
123: PROMPT_RE = rb"(?:^|\n)[\w.\-]*-> ?"
124: # vAOS shows the login prompt before it accepts configuration. Until it is
125: # ready, config commands answer with one of these errors: wait and retry.
126: NOT_READY_RE = (
127:     rb"has not reached the ready state|not permitted during initialization"
128: )
129: READY_RETRY_DELAY = 10
130: READY_TIMEOUT = 900  # seconds
131: # Boot is complete when this line shows on the console (same check as the
132: # GNS3 deploy script). Only then do we log in and configure.
133: LINK_UP_RE = rb"\+\+\+ Link 1/1/1 operationally up"
134: BOOT_TIMEOUT = 600  # seconds
135: 
136: 
137: class VAOS_vm(vrnetlab.VM):
138:     def __init__(self, hostname, username, password, nics, conn_mode):
139:         disk_image = None
140:         kernel = None
141:         initrd = None
142:         hdb = None
143:         for e in sorted(os.listdir("/")):
144:             if re.search(r"\.qcow2$", e) and "-overlay" not in e:
145:                 disk_image = "/" + e
146:             elif re.search(r"bzImage$", e):
147:                 kernel = "/" + e
148:             elif re.search(r"ramdisk.*\.gz$", e):
149:                 initrd = "/" + e
150:             elif re.search(r"chassis_info.*\.tar$", e):
151:                 hdb = "/" + e
152: 
153:         if not disk_image:
154:             raise RuntimeError("No .qcow2 disk image found in /")
155: 
156:         # ram=2048, smp=2 per the gns3a; driveif/ide + e1000 are vrnetlab defaults
157:         super(VAOS_vm, self).__init__(
158:             username,
159:             password,
160:             disk_image=disk_image,
161:             ram=2048,
162:             smp="2",
163:             driveif="ide",
164:         )
165: 
166:         self.hostname = hostname
167:         self.conn_mode = conn_mode
168:         self.port_map = PORT_MAP
169:         # expose all defined ports (max); vrnetlab only instantiates NICs for
170:         # interfaces actually wired in the topology.
171:         self.num_nics = max(nics, len(PORT_MAP) - 1)
172:         self.nic_type = "e1000"
173:         self._log_port_map()
174: 
175:         # Boot via the custom kernel + initrd + append, and attach the second
176:         # (chassis-info) disk as IDE -> becomes hdb.
177:         # vrnetlab runs qemu via "shell=True", so the multi-word -append value
178:         # must be quoted or the shell word-splits it (qemu then treats tokens
179:         # like "GNS3=1" as bare disk-image args).
180:         self.qemu_args.extend(
181:             ["-kernel", kernel, "-initrd", initrd, "-append", '"' + KERNEL_APPEND + '"']
182:         )
183:         if hdb:
184:             self.qemu_args.extend(["-drive", "if=ide,file=" + hdb + ",format=raw"])
185: 
186:         self.logger.info(
187:             "vAOS boot files: kernel=%s initrd=%s hda=%s hdb=%s",
188:             kernel, initrd, disk_image, hdb,
189:         )

191:     # ---- NIC placement --------------------------------------------------
192:     # vrnetlab enumerates NICs by PCI slot. To get a clean
193:     # container-ethN -> vAOS-1/1/N mapping with EMP as the management port, we
194:     # force every NIC onto bridge pci.1 with explicit, ordered slots and
195:     # reserve the slot at MGMT_NIC_INDEX for the management NIC (= EMP).
196: 
197:     @staticmethod
198:     def _eth_to_nic_index(eth_i):
199:         """container eth index -> guest NIC index (skipping the EMP/mgmt slot)."""
200:         return eth_i - 1 if eth_i - 1 < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else eth_i
201: 
202:     @staticmethod
203:     def _set_slot(dev_str, nic_index):
204:         """Force a -device string onto pci.1 at slot (nic_index + 1)."""
205:         dev_str = re.sub(r",bus=pci\.\d+", "", dev_str)
206:         dev_str = re.sub(r",addr=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+", "", dev_str)
207:         return dev_str + ",bus=pci.1,addr=0x%x" % (nic_index + 1)
208: 
209:     def gen_mgmt(self):
210:         # Put the management NIC on the EMP slot (guest index 2).
211:         res = super().gen_mgmt()
212:         for i, tok in enumerate(res):
213:             if tok == "-device":
214:                 res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], MGMT_NIC_INDEX)
215:         return res
216: 
217:     def gen_nics(self):
218:         # Re-slot each data NIC so container ethN lands on its target guest index.
219:         res = super().gen_nics()
220:         # vrnetlab skips NICs above the highest wired ethN, and the guest numbers
221:         # NICs in enumeration order. If eth1/eth2 are not wired, the management
222:         # NIC shifts down and is no longer EMP. Always add unconnected dummies.
223:         present = set(int(n) for n in re.findall(r"netdev=p(\d+)", " ".join(res)))
224:         for eth_i in range(1, MGMT_NIC_INDEX + 1):
225:             if eth_i not in present:
226:                 res.extend([
227:                     "-device", "%s,netdev=p%02d" % (self.nic_type, eth_i),
228:                     "-netdev", "socket,id=p%02d,listen=:%d" % (eth_i, 10000 + eth_i),
229:                 ])
230:         for i, tok in enumerate(res):
231:             if tok == "-device":
232:                 m = re.search(r"netdev=p(\d+)", res[i + 1])
233:                 if m:
234:                     eth_i = int(m.group(1))
235:                     res[i + 1] = self._set_slot(res[i + 1], self._eth_to_nic_index(eth_i))
236:         return res
237: 
238:     def _log_port_map(self):
239:         """Log the container-interface <-> vAOS-port mapping for the operator."""
240:         self.logger.info("vAOS NIC mapping (EMP = vrnetlab management):")
241:         for nic in sorted(self.port_map):
242:             port = self.port_map[nic]
243:             if nic == MGMT_NIC_INDEX:
244:                 src = "vrnetlab management (NAT, or container eth0 in mgmt-passthrough)"
245:             else:
246:                 eth = nic + 1 if nic < MGMT_NIC_INDEX else nic
247:                 src = "container eth%d" % eth
248:             self.logger.info("  guest NIC%-2d  vAOS %-8s  <-  %s", nic, port, src)
249:         self.logger.info("  => eth1=1/1/1, eth2=1/1/2, eth3=1/1/3 ... EMP = management")
250: 
251:     def bootstrap_spin(self):
252:         """Poll the serial console until the OmniSwitch login prompt appears."""
253:         if self.spins > 6000:
254:             self.logger.warning("Too many spins, restarting VM")
255:             self.stop()
256:             self.start()
257:             return
258: 
259:         (ridx, match, res) = self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 1)
260:         # keep the boot output, in case the link-up line shows before login:
261:         self._boot_out = getattr(self, "_boot_out", b"") + res
262:         if match and ridx == 0:
263:             self.logger.info("vAOS reached login prompt")
264:             if os.environ.get("VAOS_BOOTSTRAP", "true").lower() != "false":
265:                 try:
266:                     self.bootstrap_config()
267:                 except Exception as e:
268:                     self.logger.error("vAOS bootstrap failed: %s", e)
269:             self.running = True
270:             self.tn.close()
271:             return
272: 
273:         if res != b"":
274:             self.logger.trace("OUTPUT: %s" % res.decode(errors="ignore"))
275:             self.spins = 0
276: 
277:         self.spins += 1
278:         return

280:     # ---- containerlab save ----------------------------------------------
281: 
282:     def work(self):
283:         super().work()
284:         if self.running and os.path.exists(SAVE_REQUEST):
285:             self.save_config()
286: 
287:     def save_config(self):
288:         """Save the configuration and store a snapshot for containerlab save."""
289:         self.logger.info("containerlab save requested")
290:         try:
291:             os.remove(SAVE_REQUEST)
292:         except OSError:
293:             pass
294:         result = "ok"
295:         try:
296:             self.tn.open()
297:             self.tn.write(b"\r")
298:             ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE, b"login:"], 15)
299:             if ridx == 1:
300:                 username = os.environ.get("VAOS_USERNAME") or self.username
301:                 password = os.environ.get("VAOS_PASSWORD") or self.password
302:                 if not self._login(username, password):
303:                     raise RuntimeError("could not log in on the console")
304:             elif ridx != 0:
305:                 raise RuntimeError("no prompt on the console (is a console session open?)")
306:             self._send("write memory flash-synchro", timeout=180)
307:             buf = self._send("show configuration snapshot", timeout=120)
308:             config = self._extract_snapshot(buf)
309:             if not config.strip():
310:                 raise RuntimeError("empty configuration snapshot")
311:             with open(SAVED_CONFIG, "w") as f:
312:                 f.write(config)
313:             self.logger.info("configuration saved to %s", SAVED_CONFIG)
314:             self.tn.write(b"exit\r")
315:         except Exception as e:
316:             result = "error: %s" % e
317:             self.logger.error("containerlab save failed: %s", e)
318:         finally:
319:             try:
320:                 self.tn.close()
321:             except Exception:
322:                 pass
323:             with open(SAVE_DONE, "w") as f:
324:                 f.write(result + "\n")
325: 
326:     @staticmethod
327:     def _extract_snapshot(buf):
328:         """Keep the configuration lines of "show configuration snapshot".
329: 
330:         Async console messages ("+++ Link 1/1/4 operationally up") can be
331:         printed in the middle of a line: "spb+++ Link ...\n isis ..." is
332:         rejoined as "spb isis ...".
333:         """
334:         lines = buf.decode(errors="ignore").replace("\r", "").split("\n")
335:         for i, line in enumerate(lines):
336:             if "show configuration snapshot" in line:
337:                 lines = lines[i + 1:]
338:                 break
339:         out = []
340:         i = 0
341:         while i < len(lines):
342:             line = lines[i]
343:             i += 1
344:             if LINE_PROMPT_RE.match(line):
345:                 break  # CLI prompt after the output
346:             if line.startswith("+++") or ASYNC_HEADER_RE.match(line):
347:                 continue  # async console message on its own line
348:             pos = line.find("+++")
349:             if pos > 0:
350:                 # message inserted mid-line: the rest of the line follows it
351:                 while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("+++"):
352:                     i += 1
353:                 rest = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else ""
354:                 i += 1
355:                 line = line[:pos] + rest
356:             out.append(line)
357:         while out and not out[-1].strip():
358:             out.pop()
359:         while out and not out[0].strip():
360:             out.pop(0)
361:         return "\n".join(out) + "\n"

363:     # ---- console bootstrap ---------------------------------------------
364: 
365:     def _send(self, cmd, timeout=30):
366:         """Send one CLI command and wait for the "->" prompt. If vAOS says it
367:         is not ready yet, wait and send the command again."""
368:         deadline = time.time() + READY_TIMEOUT
369:         while True:
370:             self.logger.info("vAOS> %s", cmd)
371:             self.tn.write((cmd + "\r").encode())
372:             ridx, _, buf = self.tn.expect([PROMPT_RE], timeout)
373:             if ridx != 0:
374:                 self.logger.warning("no prompt after '%s' (continuing)", cmd)
375:                 return buf
376:             if not re.search(NOT_READY_RE, buf):
377:                 return buf
378:             if time.time() > deadline:
379:                 self.logger.error("vAOS still not ready after %ds, giving up on '%s'",
380:                                   READY_TIMEOUT, cmd)
381:                 return buf
382:             self.logger.info("vAOS not ready yet, retrying in %ds", READY_RETRY_DELAY)
383:             time.sleep(READY_RETRY_DELAY)
384: 
385:     def _sync_emp_mac(self, emp):
386:         """mgmt passthrough: copy the EMP MAC address to the container eth0.
387: 
388:         vrnetlab gives the container eth0 the MAC of the VM management NIC, so
389:         that traffic for the ports kept in the container (5000-5007, serial
390:         console) is accepted by the container. vAOS does not use that MAC for
391:         EMP but its own, so the launcher learns it with an ARP probe sent to
392:         the VM on tap0 and sets it on eth0.
393:         """
394:         ip = socket.inet_aton(emp.split("/")[0])
395:         try:
396:             with open("/sys/class/net/%s/address" % self.mgmt_intf) as f:
397:                 src = bytes.fromhex(f.read().strip().replace(":", ""))
398:             # ETH_P_ALL: frames from the VM are redirected to eth0 by tc on tap0
399:             # ingress; only an ETH_P_ALL socket sees them before that
400:             sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET, socket.SOCK_RAW, socket.htons(0x0003))
401:             sock.bind(("tap0", 0))
402:             sock.settimeout(1)
403:         except OSError as e:
404:             self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync skipped: %s", e)
405:             return
406:         # ARP probe: who-has <EMP IP>, sender IP 0.0.0.0
407:         probe = (b"\xff" * 6 + src + b"\x08\x06"
408:                  + struct.pack("!HHBBH", 1, 0x0800, 6, 4, 1)
409:                  + src + b"\x00" * 4 + b"\x00" * 6 + ip)
410:         mac = None
411:         deadline = time.time() + 30
412:         try:
413:             while mac is None and time.time() < deadline:
414:                 sock.send(probe)
415:                 end = time.time() + 2
416:                 while time.time() < end:
417:                     try:
418:                         pkt = sock.recv(2048)
419:                     except socket.timeout:
420:                         break
421:                     # ARP (reply, or gratuitous ARP) sent by the VM from the EMP IP
422:                     if len(pkt) >= 42 and pkt[12:14] == b"\x08\x06" \
423:                             and pkt[28:32] == ip and pkt[22:28] != src:
424:                         mac = pkt[22:28]
425:                         break
426:         finally:
427:             sock.close()
428:         if mac is None:
429:             self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: no ARP reply from EMP")
430:             return
431:         mac_str = ":".join("%02x" % b for b in mac)
432:         res = subprocess.run(["ip", "link", "set", "dev", self.mgmt_intf, "address", mac_str],
433:                              capture_output=True, text=True)
434:         if res.returncode != 0:
435:             self.logger.warning("EMP MAC sync: %s", res.stderr.strip())
436:             return
437:         self.logger.info("EMP MAC %s copied to container %s", mac_str, self.mgmt_intf)
438: 
439:     def _login(self, username, password):
440:         """Log in on the console. The first login prompt can come before AAA
441:         is ready, so retry a few times."""
442:         for attempt in range(1, LOGIN_RETRIES + 1):
443:             self.logger.info("vAOS console login attempt %d as %s", attempt, username)
444:             self.tn.write((username + "\r").encode())
445:             ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect([b"assword:"], 30)
446:             if ridx != 0:
447:                 self.tn.write(b"\r")
448:                 self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
449:                 continue
450:             self.tn.write((password + "\r").encode())
451:             ridx, _, _ = self.tn.expect(
452:                 [PROMPT_RE, rb"Authentication failure|Login incorrect"], 60
453:             )
454:             if ridx == 0:
455:                 self.logger.info("vAOS console login OK")
456:                 return True
457:             self.logger.warning("vAOS login failed, retrying in %ds", LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
458:             time.sleep(LOGIN_RETRY_DELAY)
459:             self.tn.write(b"\r")
460:             self.tn.expect([b"login:"], 30)
461:         return False

463:     def _push_config(self, path):
464:         """Send a startup config to the CLI, one line at a time."""
465:         with open(path, errors="ignore") as f:
466:             lines = [l.strip() for l in f]
467:         cmds = [l for l in lines if l and not l.startswith("!")]
468:         self.logger.info("pushing startup config %s (%d commands)", path, len(cmds))
469:         errors = 0
470:         for cmd in cmds:
471:             buf = self._send(cmd, timeout=60)
472:             if re.search(rb"\bERROR\b", buf):
473:                 errors += 1
474:                 self.logger.warning("startup config line rejected: %s", cmd)
475:         self.logger.info("startup config pushed: %d commands, %d rejected",
476:                          len(cmds), errors)
